🎮 《CropDuster Supreme》犀利点评：

这款游戏是一款由 kChamp Games 开发的动作休闲独立游戏，玩家将扮演一位名叫 Buster 的角色，在吃下“Burrito Hut”墨西哥卷饼后，利用放屁的能力穿越九个日常场景，以赢得心仪女孩的芳心 。


🧄 核心玩法：放屁闯关，笑料百出
游戏的主要机制是通过放屁来影响周围的 NPC，使他们逃离场景，从而完成关卡目标。每个场景都有独特的布局和挑战，玩家需要巧妙地运用“屁力”来达成任务。

✅ 优点：
创意十足的题材：以放屁为核心玩法，独树一帜，令人印象深刻。

幽默风趣的剧情：游戏充满了搞笑元素，剧情轻松愉快，适合放松心情。

价格亲民：游戏售价仅为 $0.99，性价比高 。

❌ 缺点：
内容较为单一：虽然关卡多样，但核心玩法变化不大，可能导致重复感。

操作略显粗糙：部分玩家反映游戏的操作手感不够流畅，影响体验。

画面简洁：游戏采用像素风格，视觉效果较为基础，可能不符合部分玩家的审美。

🎯 总结：
《CropDuster Supreme》是一款创意独特、幽默风趣的休闲游戏，适合寻求轻松娱乐的玩家。尽管存在一些不足，但其独特的题材和亲民的价格使其值得一试。

I am 32 years old.

My ex-wife and I have a daughter together, and we adopted our son together. Both are now 4 years old.

When we were going through our separation, I felt lost and unhappy. I was self-destructive. One day, I was so angry with everything spiraling out of control that I punched a concrete wall in a moment of overwhelming emotion. This resulted in breaking my fifth metacarpal in my right hand—the hand I worked with, played games with, and used to carry my children to bed—the hand I desperately needed to ensure I could continue providing.

Upon learning the severity of the self-inflicted damage, I became almost suicidal. Keep in mind that just a few months before this, I was the happiest man, with no history of depression or anxiety. I had never experienced anger outbursts, nor was I the type to break down and cry, but I was in a tough situation that truly prevented me from seeing the light on the other side.

With nothing better to do, I looked for a game I could play WITH ONE HAND while recovering. Somehow, I stumbled upon this game and read some of the comments. I decided it was worth a try... I must admit I didn't beat the game, nor did I play as much as some of you. In fact, I may have played this game for only a day or two. That being said, after doing so, I had a new joy and hope for life. I managed to leave behind the pain and suffering that had been thrust upon me. I could experience the joy and happiness of other people. I relaxed for 5 ♥♥♥♥ minutes listening to this music, long enough to realize that I would be okay.

After realizing this, I turned off the game and went back to work. My hand hurt a lot, but I was motivated. I stopped feeling so sorry for myself and became the father I needed to be at that moment, not the weak boy I was behaving like.

Today, I am close friends with the mother of my children. We don't fight, argue, or say hurtful things to each other. We are parents and friends.

Now I have 3 children. My third child is, wait, ALSO 4 YEARS OLD. The woman I am with was going through a very similar situation at the time of my separation, and we just unexpectedly stumbled into each other's lives. We have been dating for a year and are very happy together.

Moral of the story: you never know what life has in store for you, and if I had given up when all odds were against me, I wouldn't be where I am today. This silly little game helped me realize that.

Thank you.

CropDuster Supreme is a badly made joke game with a flatulence theme as you try to expose as many NPCs in the game to flatus.  That's all there is to it... it was probably slapped together in the space of an afternoon and quickly dumped onto Steam "for the lulz".  There's no serious value or merit to the game, removing the gas component leaves just a simple 2D retro pixel top down action game. 

From a technical perspective, the game doesn't meet basic minimum requirements that most PC gamers expect as standard.

A choice was made to use obsolete, decades old retro pixel "art" as a substitute for contemporary PC graphics.  It's unclear if this is due to lack of budget or talent, regardless, the overall visual quality of the game is extremely low as a result.

While there are options to change the resolution for the game, all this does is scale up the simplistic 2D art assets used to make the game, which makes little or no difference to the graphics quality.  Without any other substantial graphics tweaks, it's not possible for gamers to improve the lacklustre 2D visuals.

The controls can't be customised, which will be an annoyance for many, but it can also render the game unplayable for differently-abled gamers, or gamers using AZERTY or other international keyboard layouts.  

These technical defects push this game below acceptable standards for any modern PC game.

You don't have to take my word about how bad the game is, we can measure the interest in a game by how much people bothered to play it.  CropDuster Supreme has achievements, and they show us a very clear picture that the game absolutely failed to capture any interest from gamers.  The most commonly and easily attained achievement is for clearing the first/tutorial level, trivial to achieve, but less than 9 percent of players bothered to get that far before uninstalling the game.  That's a tiny, tiny proportion of gamers who even bothered with this.  Ouch.

Reviewing SteamDB to check how popular this game was with players reveals a surprise... there's a very healthy spike in player counts for the game.  But this isn't consistent with the achievement stats, that show less than 9 percent of players bothered playing the game for any reasonable amount of time.  How is it possible for this game to have so many concurrent players who didn't bother to played the game?  Trading cards.  People will use card idling software to collect the cards and sell them, but this won't trigger any achievements in-game.

That tells us people only really bought this game for trading cards, and that's a damning indictment of the woeful quality.  A closer look at the numbers shows the game just has a couple of players every week running up the game and idling it for cards, then deleting it.  We must ask how it benefits gamers for there to be so many games like this, with no merit as a serious game, that only generate sales from people idling and selling the trading cards.

CropDuster Supreme is relatively cheap at $1 USD, but it's not worth it. Given the defects and quality issues with the game, coupled with the unrealistic price, this is impossible to recommend.

[b]Note:[/b] Because this is more of a "joke" game, intended to draw attention from controversy or in the hopes of going viral because it's "so bad it's good" (but it isn't good at all), there's nothing here to offer to serious gamers.  As usual, with most awful/joke games, all the comedians come out of the woodwork.  The vast majority of the reviews for this game are joke reviews, such as "this game cured my cancer, saved my marriage, changed my life" etc.  Because most of the reviews are as insincere as the game itself is, and if you removed the fake/joke reviews the game would have a markedly different review score, the positive review score for this game should be disregarded.

《CropDuster Supreme》是一款休闲游戏，其独特的玩法是通过放屁把人熏走，旨在给玩家带来轻松愉快的游戏体验。然而在我深入体验这款游戏后，却发现它并未能带给我预期的趣味和娱乐，反而存在一些明显的乏味与短板。

首先从游戏的核心玩法来看放屁机制显得过于简单和重复。玩家只需控制角色放屁，将周围的敌人熏走即可。这种单一的操作方式缺乏足够的策略性和深度，使得游戏过程变得单调乏味。同时游戏中的关卡设计也相对简单，缺乏足够的挑战性和变化，使得玩家在游玩过程中很难保持长久的兴趣。

其次游戏的画面和音效表现也令人失望。画面质量平平，缺乏足够的细节和色彩，使得角色和场景的呈现显得单调和缺乏吸引力。音效方面，放屁声音虽然有趣，但缺乏多样性和创意，无法为游戏营造出足够的幽默和娱乐氛围。这种视觉和听觉上的不足使得游戏的整体体验大打折扣。

再者游戏中的角色和场景设计也显得缺乏创意和多样性。角色造型单一，缺乏个性和特色，使得玩家在游戏中难以产生强烈的代入感。场景布局也相对简单，缺乏足够的细节和变化，使得游戏世界显得单调乏味。

此外游戏的控制和操作体验也不尽如人意。控制不够流畅，反应不够灵敏，使得玩家在放屁熏人时经常感到困惑和不满。这种操作上的不便进一步降低了游戏的可玩性和趣味性。

最后从性价比的角度来看同样令人失望。相较于其他同类休闲游戏，它在玩法、画面、音效、角色和场景设计以及操作体验等方面都未能达到玩家的期望水平，而价格却相对较高。这使得这款游戏的性价比显得非常低，不建议玩家购买。

综上所述，在核心玩法、画面音效、角色和场景设计以及操作体验等方面都存在明显的乏味与短板，使得整体的游戏体验缺乏趣味和吸引力。如果你正在寻找一款轻松有趣且富有创意的休闲游戏，那么我建议你避开这款游戏，以免浪费时间和金钱。希望开发者能够在未来的版本中针对这些问题进行改进和优化，为玩家带来更好的游戏体验。
